notes: All six planned kinds kept. Archetypes: turkey breeds and labels (Bronze, Broad Breasted White, Norfolk Black, KellyBronze, Dinde de Bresse, Bourbon Red, Narragansett); duck breeds (American Pekin, Aylesbury, Gressingham, Barbary, Challans, Mulard); magret; Embden and Toulouse geese; foie gras by duck/goose and the IGP Sud-Ouest. Old models became versions. Grades given as US A/B/C (the fetched page does not give French extra/A/B, so those were left out). Prepared foie gras (mi-cuit, bloc) left to the deli shelf. Rougié founding year left out (not confirmed on a fetched page).
